Here are a few examples of presentations I've given. I'm always eager to speak with others about the ways AI, statistics, and effective data communication intersect and how they can better support our day-to-day lives and our work processes. If you have an event or conference in mind, please [get in touch](mailto:chester.ismay@gmail.com).

<div class="talk-grid">

::: {.card}
**The Monday Morning Agent**  
An eight-episode O'Reilly live series I host, every other Monday starting October 2026. Each episode uses real NFL play-by-play data to settle an enduring football debate while gradually building an AI data analyst that can do that work on its own.

→ [Series page](https://learning.oreilly.com/live-events/the-monday-morning-agent/0642572456054/)
:::

::: {.card}
**Never Miss a Game: Build a Sports Concierge Agent in 25 Minutes**  
A live 30-minute demo and Q&A in O'Reilly's [Zero to Agent in 30 Minutes](https://learning.oreilly.com/live-events/zero-to-agent-in-30-minutes/0642572392338/) series (September 16, 2026). What are agents good for when they aren't writing code? I build a sports concierge agent that reads the schedules for every sport I follow, picks the events worth my time, and sends one message to my phone each week, then hand over the repeatable pattern: prompt file, tool permissions, schedule, and notification.

→ [Recap and video](https://www.oreilly.com/radar/zero-to-agent-in-30-minutes-build-a-sports-concierge-agent-with-chester-ismay/)  
→ [Walkthrough](https://ismayc.github.io/never-miss-a-game/)
:::
